caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a male figure with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a red coat that has yellow trim on the sleeves and buttons. Underneath the coat, he wears a blue scarf or sash draped prominently in the front, along with a white garment that appears at the neckline and right wrist. The figure is shown from the waist up, with both arms bent and partially obscured by the blue sash. The figure faces slightly to the right of the viewer. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or designs present. The colors used are predominantly red, blue, white, brown, and yellow, and the image is rendered with visible brushstrokes and shading to indicate texture and volume.
title: Figurehead
